results.evidence: `resolve_untagged_followup_mode` now returns `get_untagged_followup_preference(...) or UntaggedFollowupMode.ASK`. A missing row or a NULL column gives `None`, so the mode is ASK. The activity then falls through to `_post_untagged_followup_prompt`, so the reply gets the prompt instead of `NEVER` and being ignored.

An explicit stored value is returned unchanged by `get_untagged_followup_preference`. The activity still does `if mode == AUTO: return False` (forward, no prompt) and `if mode == NEVER: ... return True` (ignored, no prompt), and an explicit ASK falls through to the prompt. The activity has no creator exemption, so the creator's own replies under `never` are still ignored.

The prompt keeps "Yes, take a look" for the single reply. When `offer_default` is set it adds "Always pick up my replies" (`_handle_untagged_followup_run(..., save_default=AUTO)`) and "Never pick up my replies" (`save_default=NEVER`), which store the setting through `_save_default_if_unset`. The default buttons are offered only to the thread creator, because the setting is read from the creator's row, so a non-creator's default would have no effect.

The patch only changes docstrings in `slack_app_home.py`. The picker takes a `mode` and uses it as `initial_option`. The code that decides whether to render the section and which mode to pass is not shown. If it calls `resolve_untagged_followup_mode`, unset users would see ASK selected. That caller is not in the excerpt, so I cannot confirm it.

`get_untagged_followup_preference` returns `None` for an unrecognised stored value: `return UntaggedFollowupMode(stored) if stored in UntaggedFollowupMode.values else None`. `resolve_untagged_followup_mode` maps `None` to `ASK`. An unrecognised value therefore now prompts instead of resolving to `NEVER`.

The prompt's context block is static text: "You can change this later from the PostHog app's Home tab." It contains no link. `app_home_url` is imported in `api.py`, but nothing in the patch uses it to build one.
The patch does not touch quota handling. The quota-check code, and whether it suppresses the denial message for unconfirmed untagged replies, is not shown, so I cannot tell if this already holds.

result:
Users with no thread follow-up setting are now prompted when they reply without tagging PostHog. I haven't run or added any tests, and I didn't check the other tests or snapshots that touch the prompt or its buttons.

- **Unset means ask:** `resolve_untagged_followup_mode` in `services/slack_settings.py` now returns "ask" for a user with no saved setting. Before, it returned "never", which is why the reply was silently ignored. A thread with no known creator still resolves to "never", since there's nobody to ask. Users who already picked auto, ask or never behave as before.
- **Home page:** the existing "Thread follow-ups" picker already shows the resolved value and saves changes. Unset users now see "Ask them first" there instead of "Leave them alone". I updated its docstring and the comment in `models.py` to match.
- **Save a default from the prompt:** the ephemeral prompt gets two extra buttons, "Always pick up my replies" and "Never pick up my replies". Each answers the current message and saves that choice. They appear only when the replier is the thread creator and has no saved setting, because the setting belongs to the creator. If the user sets a preference in the meantime, the click won't overwrite it.
- **Where it changed:** the prompt and click handlers are in `products/slack_app/backend/api.py`. The workflow activity in `posthog/temporal/ai/slack_app/activities/messaging.py` decides when to show the extra buttons.
- **Tests:** I updated the existing expectations in `test_slack_settings.py` and `test_thread_message_routing.py` for the unset case. I added no new tests for the new buttons.
